attributes.purpose: Total return for each of the last ten calendar years plus year-to-date, as a bar chart.
Share of the portfolio by credit rating of fixed-income holdings; equities and cash shown as their own lines.
Regulatory disclaimers, footnote definitions and the link to further commentary.
Growth of a hypothetical $10,000 investment over ten years, as a line chart with the end value called out.
Identifies the fund, series and category; carries the brand.
The holdings selected as most significant for understanding the portfolio, by asset class, with their weights; plus the total count of holdings.
Size, price, costs, benchmark, last distribution and purchase codes of the fund and series.
The teams and named individuals responsible for the portfolio.
Where the portfolio's assets sit, by asset class then country; sums to 100%.
Annualized total return of the series over standard periods ending at as_of; the primary performance table.
Standard three-year risk statistics of the series against its benchmark.
The fund's risk rating on the five-level scale required by the prospectus.
Share of the portfolio by economic sector (fixed income counted as one sector); sums to 100%.
Marketing bullets approved by compliance describing the investment approach.
